name: botnote
description: Agent-native tasks, notes, memory, and project context for Cursor.

botnote_url.title: botnote daemon URL
botnote_url.description: Leave empty for a daemon on this machine (http://127.0.0.1:4280). For a remote daemon enter its URL, e.g. https://botnote.example.com, and set botnote_token.

botnote_token.title: API bearer token
botnote_token.description: Required for public or token-gated botnote URLs. Generate one in Settings -> API tokens. Not needed when botnote_url points to a trusted local daemon.
